newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Hermes Europe Railtel sells $265 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Hermes Europe Railtel sells $265 mln notes.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of debt from Hermes Europe Railtel B.V. was priced on Thursday via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, according to a market source.
The deal was increased to $265 million from an original size of $175 million in order to meet strong market demand.
Hermes Europe, a start-up venture based in the Netherlands, is building a fiber-optic telephone network that will connect major cities in western and central Europe.

Equity investors in the company include Global TeleSystems Group Inc, a private U.S. company whose major shareholders include George Soros, and Hit Rail BV, a consortium of eleven European railroad lines.
